description: 本課只處理 physical = bodily / relating to the body 的 sense。 也就是「身體的、肉體的、與身體有關的」，不處理 physical object = 實體物件、physical copy = 紙本／實體副本 等其他意思。

options.explanation: Bodily ✓ — means connected with the body and is especially natural with harm, injury, functions and needs. In this sentence, harm to the body is the established collocation bodily harm; that combination of meaning, register and collocation makes Bodily the best answer.

Corporeal — is formal/literary and normally contrasts the body with the mind, spirit or soul. It is a genuine learner-facing option, but it is less suitable here because harm to the body is the established collocation bodily harm.

Somatic — is a medical/scientific term for bodily symptoms or processes, often contrasted with psychological ones. It is a genuine learner-facing option, but it is less suitable here because harm to the body is the established collocation bodily harm.

Material — means relating to matter/materials, not to the body in this sense. It is a genuine learner-facing option, but it is less suitable here because harm to the body is the established collocation bodily harm.

Tangible — means touchable or concrete, which belongs to a different sense of physical. It is a genuine learner-facing option, but it is less suitable here because harm to the body is the established collocation bodily harm.

Mental — refers to the mind and is often the contrast term rather than a synonym. It is a genuine learner-facing option, but it is less suitable here because harm to the body is the established collocation bodily harm.

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Material is not a synonym when physical means bodily.

falseSynonyms.zh: 可觸摸的 ≠ bodily tangible 表示可觸摸或具體存在，不等於與身體有關。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Tangible belongs to the 'concrete/real' sense of physical.

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Manual is hand-related, not body-related in general.

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Mental is often the contrast term.

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Medical is healthcare-related, not simply bodily.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在身體機能 sense 接近 physiological 重點是生理功能，不涵蓋所有身體層面。

falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Use physically when an adverb is required.
